disableGroups.label: Foot/toe tracking and animation
disableGroups.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive toe axis values or toe control toggles; the remote toe PhysBone/animation state can fall back to its default.

disableGroups.label: Nemesis wand and projectile state
disableGroups.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive wand take/reload/aim/fire/selection state. Non-local clients may render the default wand or omit transient effects.

disableGroups.label: Sleep, crouch and Supine state
disableGroups.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive sleep/supine, crouch pose, root-height or foot-anchor state. This group is optional and is normally absent from the minimal FullFT test avatar.

disableGroups.label: Legacy facial preset selector
disableGroups.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive the locally selected legacy facial set. The source drivers are local-only, so remote clients otherwise stay at set 0. Current FaceLock/Fasial result state remains protected.

disableGroups.label: Nonessential FullFT cohabitation controls
disableGroups.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive the legacy manual FaceLock/Fasial preset selection, shield toggle, jump-collider toggle, face-petting gesture state, head-petting toggle, or tail-collider toggle. High-frequency FT/v2 tracking, the eight VRCFT controls, MF3 geometry, and placement remain direct.
